analysis.evidence: Pharaoh gives orders to אֲנָשִׁים, “men,” concerning Abram (עָלָיו). The next verb, וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ, tells what the men did in response: they sent Abram away with his wife and all he had.
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וַ־ introduces a Piel wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with Pharaoh as its subject.
